summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an ATM Equity Offering Sales Agreement to sell up to $750 million of common stock through multiple agents, replacing a prior ATM program under which $279.9 million remained unsold. The sales may be made at prevailing market prices through at-the-market offerings, block trades, or negotiated transactions, with no fixed price, premium, or board recommendation disclosed. This is a routine equity shelf facility, not a transformative special situation. What to watch: actual takedown pace and dilution impact, but no risk-arb angle applies.
